queries.result: First-party discovery in Portuguese found the municipal Cadastro Imobiliário and Geoprocessamento contacts, the official GeoMais portal, and a municipal report describing georeferenced cadastral updating. registryCustodian: Prefeitura Municipal de Gravataí, Secretaria Municipal de Desenvolvimento Urbano (SMDUR) / Cadastro Imobiliário and Geoprocessamento; SMFPO is the municipal Fazenda, Planejamento e Orçamento department.

registryEvidence.evidence: The official municipal SMDUR contact page separately identifies Cadastro Imobiliário and Geoprocessamento, and the official municipality-specific GeoMais portal identifies Gravataí by idMunicipio=166 and offers an Acesso Público control. The portal shell is public, but current map access was not anonymously verified.
